keys.title: Browser extension
keys.intro: The SonNuage extension adds an “Add to SonNuage” button on YouTube and YouTube Music (the repository’s extension/ folder, loaded “unpacked”). It connects with a key created here: the key can only queue videos, subscribe and send YouTube cookies. It gives no access to the library or the rest of the admin pages. A key stops working as soon as it’s revoked, or if its creator is no longer an administrator.

help.title: Help
help.intro: The essentials for listening, organizing and tuning SonNuage. Tap a question to show its answer.

play.a: Tap a track (double-click on desktop): the list it belongs to plays from that track. The play button of an album, playlist or artist plays all of it.

queue.a: A track's ⋮ menu offers “Play next” and “Add to queue”. The queue is shown from the player or the Queue page.

playlists.a: The heart adds a track to “Liked songs”. “Add to playlist”, in the ⋮ menu, files it in an existing or new playlist.

search.a: Search covers artists, albums and tracks, and tolerates typos. On desktop, the / key jumps to the search box.

shuffle.a: “Shuffle the whole library”, on the home page, plays all your music in random order.

quality.a: Choose the playback quality. On Android, a separate quality applies on mobile data to save data. “Original” sends the file as is, FLAC included.

prefetch.a: Upcoming tracks are downloaded ahead so playback keeps going when the network weakens.

crossfade.a: From 0 to 5 seconds: the next track starts while the current one fades out.

infinite.a: At the end of the queue, SonNuage adds similar tracks (same genre, then same artist). This setting and crossfade follow your account on all your devices.

web.a: SonNuage works in any recent browser, nothing to install. After a server update, a banner offers to reload the page.

android.a: The Android app plays in the background and shows up in Android Auto. Installed outside the Play Store, it needs “Unknown sources” turned on in Android Auto's developer settings.

desktop.a: The desktop app has the same interface in its own window.

cuts.q: Playback cuts out on the go
cuts.a: Lower the mobile-data quality or raise the number of preloaded tracks in Settings.

missing.a: Albums come from the server's music folder: the administrator drops the files there and the scan adds them. Let them know if an album is missing or misfiled.

password.a: Ask your server's administrator to reset it. Once signed in, you can change it in Settings.

back.a: It first closes the open menu, dialog or full-screen player, then goes back to the previous page.
